summary: Added a hand-built 'auth' command (login --chrome, login --manual, status) since the internal-YAML spec has no cookie/composed-auth type.
reason: Creative Center uses a login session cookie plus an X-CSRFToken header with no official API key. The spec declares auth.type: none so generation would not gate on a missing key env var; this hand-built client layer captures cookies + CSRF from a logged-in Chrome profile (via chromedp) and writes them into config.toml's [headers], which the generated HTTP client already applies to every request without further edits.
validated_outcome: auth login --chrome captured 47 cookies + CSRF token from a real logged-in session; auth status correctly reports masked configured/missing state; doctor confirms API reachable post-auth.
